tools.name: get_fmr_by_county
tools.description: HUD FY 2027 Fair Market Rents (effective Oct 1, 2026) for one county, parish or New England town: studio to 4-bedroom, the HUD FMR area it belongs to, whether FY 2026 rents stay in effect there, one- and five-year change in the 2-bedroom FMR, and the 2-bedroom history back to FY 2017.

tools.name: get_fmr_by_zip
tools.description: HUD FY 2027 Small Area Fair Market Rents (ZIP-level, effective Oct 1, 2026) for one ZIP code, studio to 4-bedroom, with the HUD FMR area. A ZIP that crosses areas returns one row per area. Small Area FMRs set voucher payment standards in the 65 mandatory metros and are optional elsewhere.

tools.name: get_state_fmr_summary
tools.description: A state's FY 2027 Fair Market Rent picture: number of counties or towns, median, lowest and highest 2-bedroom FMR, median one- and five-year change, and the places that rose or fell most. Omit state for the national summary.

tools.name: compare_fmr
tools.description: Side-by-side HUD FY 2027 Fair Market Rents for 2 to 10 counties (studio to 4-bedroom) with one- and five-year 2-bedroom change, sorted by the bedroom count you choose. Useful for comparing rental markets or voucher rent ceilings.
